parole.significato: In full Idaho potato: a variety of potato grown in Idaho, especially the Russet Burbank.
parole.testo: Uncertain; possibly from Plains Apache ídaahȩ́ (“Comanche”), though the Oxford English Dictionary states that the development of the state’s name from that word remains undocumented.
